source.author: verg
source.text: Tris imbris torti radios, tris nubis aquosae addiderant, rutili tris ignis et alitis austri:
source.text_original: Tris imbris torti radios, tris nubis aquosae / addiderant, rutili tris ignis et alitis austri: /
source.text_english: They had added three rays of twisted rain, three of watery cloud, and three of glowing fire and winged south wind.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: imbrem et tenebras saevumque tridentem iam iam ego et inviti torsissem coniugis ignem.
reuse.text_original: imbrem et tenebras saevumque tridentem / iam iam ego et inviti torsissem coniugis ignem.
reuse.text_english: I myself would already now have hurled rain and darkness and the savage trident, and my wife’s fire, though unwillingly.
